summary: Iteration 10 (commission mgmt, vendor earnings, delivery boy panel, smart assignment, WhatsApp helper, admin sales analytics, vendor performance) tested end-to-end. Backend: new pytest file tests/test_iteration10_business.py — 28/28 pass. Targeted regression: 134 previously existing cases (backend_test, it6/7/8/9, vendor_phase1) all pass. Frontend: FOUND AND FIXED a critical white-screen crash (missing DeliveryPanel import in App.js) that broke the ENTIRE app; after the fix, admin analytics, delivery-boys CRUD, order assignment, WhatsApp deep-link buttons, vendor commission input, delivery panel (dashboard/my-orders/history + status buttons) and vendor earnings-breakdown all verified working. One real UI defect remains: revenue trend chart bars render at 0px height.

minor.issue: platform_commission_earned / vendor payout are recomputed at READ time using the vendor's CURRENT commission_pct, so changing a vendor's % retroactively rewrites historical commission for already-delivered orders (verified: raising 20%->40% changed commission on previously delivered orders). Recommend snapshotting commission_pct (or commission amount) on the order line at delivery time.

total_revenue is the sum of ALL delivered orders ever (not limited by ?days window) while daily_trend respects the window — KPI card labelled inside a 'Last 14 days' view is therefore misleading. Also total_revenue (order totals incl. delivery fee) != commission + vendor payout (line totals), which looks like a math error in the UI (₹1710 vs 117+1053).

Deleting a delivery partner leaves delivery_partner_id/name/earning on their orders (dangling assignment still shown in Admin Orders). Consider unassigning or blocking delete when active orders exist.

Buckets today/week/month are computed from order created_at, not from the delivered timestamp, so an old order delivered today counts in an old bucket (never in 'today'). Minor business-logic inconsistency.

ui_bugs.issue: Chart bars are invisible: bar div uses style height:{n}% but its parent column (flex flex-1 flex-col) has auto height (measured parentHeight=19px, bar height=0px). Chart area is blank with only date labels. Fix: give the column h-full + justify-end (or use a fixed-height bar track).
Commission saves only on blur (onBlur); pressing Enter does nothing and gives no feedback. Add onKeyDown Enter -> commit for usability.

issues: Revenue trend card is an empty white block because of the 0-height bars
KPI 'Total revenue' (all-time) sits next to window-scoped chart which reads as inconsistent

action_items: CRITICAL (already patched by tester, please keep): App.js was missing `import DeliveryPanel from "@/pages/DeliveryPanel"` — every route rendered a blank page with 'DeliveryPanel is not defined'. Ensure future route additions include the import and do a quick smoke load.
Fix the Revenue trend bar heights in Admin Analytics (parent column needs h-full/justify-end).
Decide on commission snapshotting so historical commission doesn't change when a vendor's % is edited.
Scope admin analytics total_revenue to the ?days window (or relabel the KPI 'all time').
Unassign delivery partner from orders on DELETE, or prevent delete while orders are assigned.
Optional: commit commission input on Enter as well as blur.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js referenced a component that was never imported — build-time lint would have caught it; add `no-undef`/CI lint gate before shipping route changes.
/app/backend/server.py is 1918 lines — split into routers (admin, vendor, delivery, orders, catalog) for maintainability.

CORS is configured with allow_credentials=True and allow_origins default '*' — invalid combination per the CORS spec (works only because auth uses Bearer tokens, not cookies). Set explicit origins via CORS_ORIGINS.
notify_order_whatsapp accepts a raw dict payload instead of a Pydantic model — no validation of event enum; unknown events silently fall back to 'update'.
delivery_update_status overwrites line_status for ALL vendors' lines on an order; for multi-vendor orders a delivery boy can mark another vendor's line Delivered — verify this is intended.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/App.js (added missing DeliveryPanel import — unblocked all frontend testing)

rca_of_the_issue: White screen on every route: /app/frontend/src/App.js added a <DeliveryPanel /> route in the iteration but never imported the component, so React threw 'DeliveryPanel is not defined' at render of <App>, unmounting the whole tree (CRA dev build does not fail on undefined JSX identifiers at compile time). Reproduced via console PAGEERROR on /login; fixed by adding the import, after which all pages render. Trend chart bug RCA: bar div height is a percentage of a parent whose height is content-driven (19px label), so computed bar height resolves to 0px.
